description: Pre-trade token safety check for trading agents, snipers and treasuries: is this ERC-20 a honeypot, what are the buy/sell taxes, can supply be minted, is ownership reclaimable, how deep is the liquidity? One call combines Honeypot.is simulation, GoPlus security audit, DexScreener liquidity, volume and pair age, and on-chain contract checks into a 0-100 risk_score, risk_level and flags for any token on Base or Ethereum. Run it before swaps, listings or purchases. Not financial advice.
name: token-risk-summary
